content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe offer a rented storefront. You get payment processing, product hosting, and delivery—until they revoke access. Their terms of service prioritize their risk models, not your revenue. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, in contrast, is a self-hosted stack. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), order storage (Supabase), and file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payment processing is handled via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured for your products. The tradeoff is clear: convenience versus control. Rented platforms simplify until they fail. Owned infrastructure requires initial setup but never fails due to your location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal and Stripe exclude countries based on financial risk, regulatory pressure, or currency instability. Nigeria, along with many other nations, faces severe restrictions or outright bans. These platforms act as gatekeepers, determining who can participate in global commerce. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. By using crypto payments and self-hosted tools, you remove intermediaries. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed on globally accessible services like Cloudflare and Supabase, which do not restrict users based on geography. Payment verification is handled on-chain, where no single entity controls access. The result is a commerce system that operates independently of any platform’s risk assessment. You’re not asking for permission—you’re building infrastructure.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal and Stripe process payments instantly but hold funds for days or weeks, especially in restricted regions. Their fees (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction) are predictable but compound with currency conversion losses and potential account freezes. Crypto payments via NOWPayments confirm on-chain within minutes, with a flat 0.5% fee. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. The real cost of conventional platforms is uncertainty: frozen accounts, sudden restrictions, and delayed payouts. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates these variables. Funds settle directly to your wallet, and you control the withdrawal process. The Edge Commerce Stack includes end-to-end testing to ensure every payment triggers automatic product delivery, no matter where the buyer is located.
Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative to rented platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On rented platforms, your customer data, sales records, and product files belong to the platform. They can revoke access at any time. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Customer data is stored in your Supabase database, product files are hosted on Cloudflare R2, and delivery is automated via Cloudflare Workers. The Edge Commerce Stack configures this automation for you, ensuring instant delivery upon payment confirmation. There are no platform dependencies—once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own the code, the data, and the process. This is infrastructure sovereignty: you’re not renting a storefront; you’re building a commerce system that cannot be taken away.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If your priority is speed of setup and you’re willing to accept geographic restrictions, rented platforms might work—until they don’t. If your priority is permanent ownership and global accessibility, sovereign infrastructure is the only option. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators who cannot afford to be locked out. It’s not a workaround; it’s a structural alternative. If you sell digital products to a global audience and need to control your payment flow, data, and delivery, this stack is built for you. The initial investment is higher than a monthly subscription, but the return is lifetime ownership. Choose rented platforms if you’re temporary. Choose sovereign infrastructure if you’re building to last.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for full automation or Sovereign Starter Stack for basic needs. 2. Provide product details and payment wallet address. 3. COREMERCH deploys your stack within 48 hours. 4. Test the payment flow using a small transaction. 5. Load your products into the system. 6. Share your store link with your audience. 7. Monitor sales via your Supabase dashboard. 8. Withdraw funds directly from your wallet.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured for you. You’ll receive a fully functional store without writing code.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform dependency. Your stack remains operational; you can switch to another processor if needed.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your crypto wallet. The stack includes a refund guide in the documentation.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for digital products only. Physical products require additional shipping infrastructure.
What if I need support after 30 days?
The stack includes 30-day support. After that, you can purchase additional support hours or use the provided documentation.
The Edge Commerce Stack gives you full ownership of your commerce system from day one.
